metric_defs.name: p99 latency
metric_defs.definition: 99th-percentile request latency under the standard mixed profile

metric_defs.name: Cache hit rate
metric_defs.how_to_measure: Gateway cache metric over a 10-min replayed-traffic window

metric_defs.name: Cost per 1k queries

metric_defs.how_to_measure: Count the 📮 entries in the Log for the period; the Log is the record, this is the roll-up

metric_defs.name: Medium posts
metric_defs.how_to_measure: Count live URLs; a draft is a Learned bullet, not a metric

metric_defs.name: Time to first token

metric_defs.how_to_measure: TTFT metric during the standard k6 profile

metric_defs.name: Robots reporting

tasks.title: ROS 2 literacy (~3h, weekday slots)
steps: Learn the seven concepts to one-sentence depth: node, topic, message type, service, action, bag, TF.
Install the `mcap` CLI + Foxglove (free tier); open a Foxglove sample bag; 20 minutes of just looking.
Rehearse the six "why robot data is hard" points out loud; deliver #5 (intermittent connectivity) and connect it to the Emma partner-outage work in the same breath.
tasks.done_means: you can describe a public bag's topics, types and rates without looking anything up.

tasks.title: mcap-tools (Saturday, ≤1 weekend, <500 lines — the sanctioned exception)
steps: `mcap info` / `mcap cat` on the IEEE DataPort bag (`rosbag2_2024_07_19_11_01_37`: 53k+ msgs, 100+ topics).
Reader: iterate messages, print channel/topic/log-time/publish-time/size; counts match `mcap info`.
Read the embedded Schema → Channel → Message records — same shape as a schema registry.
Writer: synthetic MCAP from scratch; `mcap doctor` passes.
Decode one CDR type (`BatteryState` or `Twist`) into a Go struct — once is enough.
tasks.done_means: repo reads a bag, prints a topic/rate summary, writes valid MCAP; frozen after this week.

tasks.title: foxglove/mcap contribution setup
steps: Watch issues; read CONTRIBUTING + the last 10 merged PRs in `go/`.
Bookmark 3 candidate issues (docs, conformance tests, reader/writer edge cases).
Note the rules: ~+100/−100 lines, issue-first for anything non-trivial, no bot PRs, draft while iterating, CI needs maintainer approval — expect latency.

tasks.title: Subscriptions + DDIA ch.1
steps: — O'Reilly + ByteByteGo, 2 newsletters, DDIA ch.1 with 3 bullets logged.

tasks.title: Dashboard v1 (G0)
steps: — finish per `dashboard-plan-v3.md`; hard stop at the timebox.

tasks.title: MCAP ingest source (Stage 1)
steps: Add an `mcap` source behind the same source interface as Kafka — **do not fork the pipeline**; the source-agnostic normaliser is the architectural argument.
Map five types → domain events: `BatteryState`→FleetBatteryReading · `Twist`→RobotVelocityCommand · `Odometry`→RobotPose · `DiagnosticArray`→RobotDiagnostic · `rosgraph Log`→RobotLogEvent.
Deliberately skip point clouds and camera frames — store reference + size only; write the *why* (cost; the interesting events are elsewhere) into the README now.
Ingest the IEEE bag end to end; normalised events land in the store.
tasks.done_means: one real bag flows through the existing pipeline, unforked.

tasks.title: AWS SAA started
steps: — buy one course (Cantrill or Maarek, pick in 10 min); module 1 Thursday; exam sits in B1 (December).

tasks.title: PR #1 (docs or conformance)
steps: — small, learns the review culture. →

tasks.title: Fleet semantics (Stage 2)
steps: Add a `robot_id` dimension; ingest the same bag ×3 under different ids to simulate a fleet.
Idempotency keys on `(robot_id, topic, log_time)` — a replayed bag converges instead of duplicating. Say the partner-identity transplant explicitly in the README.
Fleet metrics: `fleet_robots_reporting` · `fleet_last_seen_seconds{robot_id}` · `fleet_events_ingested_total{robot_id,topic}` · `fleet_battery_percent{robot_id}` · `fleet_dlq_depth`.
**One** Grafana dashboard: robots reporting, last-seen heatmap, battery per robot, ingest rate by topic, DLQ depth.
`GET /fleet/{robot_id}/timeline?from=&to=`.
tasks.done_means: replay converges; the dashboard is live.

tasks.title: AI leg (Stage 3, half a day)
steps: Point the bounded-evidence summariser at fleet events: "Summarise robot-02, 14:00–14:30."
Confirm unsupported-citation rejection fires on fleet windows too.
tasks.done_means: one grounded fleet summary, demo-ready. Lead with it.

tasks.title: Ship + apply
steps: README rewritten around fleet telemetry, problem-mapping table near the top (partner outage → robot offline · idempotent partner keys → device convergence · DLQ/replay → store-and-forward backfill).
`docker compose up` + a documented one-liner that ingests a public bag and populates the dashboard.
60–90s screen recording (dashboard + one AI summary), linked in README.
CV synapse entry re-nouned; **apply to Rerun (Infrastructure)** with artifact + recording.
tasks.done_means: application sent with the artifact linked (G20). Never slip this.

tasks.title: MQTT third source
steps: Paho Go client + embedded `mochi-mqtt` broker for tests.
Publish a subset of normalised events at QoS 1, consume back; duplicates converge via the same keys — the source abstraction proven real.

Know cold: QoS 0/1/2 (and why teams avoid 2), persistent sessions/clean start, retained messages, **Last Will and Testament as the offline detector**, Paho's `Store` requirement, topic wildcards vs Kafka partitioning.
tasks.done_means: convergence demo; you can explain QoS 1 vs at-least-once Kafka handled identically.

tasks.title: Medium #1
steps: — "What robot fleets and third-party logistics have in common," straight from the mapping table. →

tasks.title: CV skills + robotics summary variant
steps: — add MCAP, ROS 2 (literacy, stated honestly), MQTT; summary variant leading with *delivering state reliably to systems you can't reach*. →

tasks.title: Golden set committed (then frozen forever)
steps: Create `eval/golden/`; exporter (`cmd/goldenexport`) dumps event windows to JSON, one file per window.
Pick 16–26 real windows across Energy / Finance / Monitoring **/ Fleet** (fleet windows exist since W3 — this is the synergy).
Hand-write 4 nasty ones: empty window, single event, one domain flooding, near-identical timestamps.
`eval/golden/README.md`: one line per file. Commit.
tasks.done_means: set in git, read-only from now on.

tasks.title: summary.v2 prompt in a versioned prompts dir
steps: `prompts/summary.v1.txt` (current) + `summary.v2.txt` with one deliberate change, diff noted in header.
`SummaryPromptVersion` loads by version via config.
tasks.done_means: either version runs by flipping one config value.

tasks.title: PR #1 shepherd + substantive issue
steps: — merge PR #1 if pending; pick the substantive Go reader/writer issue for PR #2; comment intent. →

tasks.title: Eval runner
steps: — `cmd/evalrun`: {v1,v2} × {model A, model B} × every golden file; capture raw output + `ValidateAgainstEvidence`; one row per combo to `eval/results/<date>.json`; `make eval`. →

tasks.title: Regression gate in CI
steps: — `make verify` fails if v2 rejection > v1 baseline; GitHub Actions job; prove it red on a broken prompt, green on revert. →

tasks.title: The sentence
steps: — "v1→v2 dropped rejection X%→Y% on a 30-window golden set (incl. fleet), 2 models." README top + CV + 📊. →

tasks.title: Medium #2

tasks.title: PR #2 (substantive)

tasks.title: k6 mixed-load baseline
steps: — fast high-rps + slow streaming clients, different keys; 10 min; snapshot to `docs/reliability/baseline.png`. →

tasks.title: Kill Redis mid-load
steps: — traffic keeps succeeding; degradation gauge captured; limits re-engage on restart; annotated graph. →

tasks.title: Kill JWKS mid-load
steps: — cached keys keep validating; staleness metric visibly rising; annotated graph. →

tasks.title: Slot starvation
steps: — slow client holds every slot; measure fast client (queue time, 429s, latency); 5 lines on what slots showed that rate limits can't. →

tasks.title: Medium #3 + honest CV numbers

tasks.title: PR #3
steps: — open; **G7 target: 3 merged by end of this week** (8 weeks from start, per the robotics plan). →

steps: — score logged; 3 weakest domains queued.

tasks.title: Isolation level, chosen on purpose

tasks.title: Checkpoint (45 min, Sat Dec 13)
steps: — interview-grade eval number? chaos falsified anything? 3 PRs merged or stale? fifth repo started? **robotics-infra vs AI-infra vs PM/founder — which leads Q1 applications?** Any bad answer → adjust B1 now. →

tasks.title: Udemy LLM course starts in the freed Thursday slot; finish DDIA. Rest counts as progress this block
Eval regression alerts (G13)
steps: 1. pick W&B (free tier) or MLflow → 2. log every eval run (params + metrics) → 3. nightly GitHub Action runs the eval and alerts on regression → 4. test the alert once on purpose.

tasks.title: Medium #4 (G8)
steps: "fine-tuning vs prompting, measured" — the W15 verdict table becomes the post.

tasks.title: DLQ + replay CLI
steps: 1. create `<topic>.dlq` → 2. consumer: N retries with backoff, then publish to DLQ with error headers → 3. small CLI to inspect + replay.
tasks.done_means: a poison message lands in the DLQ and replays clean.

tasks.title: Idempotency proof
steps: 1. event UUID + unique constraint / processed table → 2. test: duplicate delivery causes exactly one effect.

tasks.title: Backpressure
steps: 1. bound in-flight work (worker pool; pause/resume the consumer on depth) → 2. slow the DB on purpose: lag grows, memory stays flat.

tasks.title: Result caching
steps: Redis cache keyed by the existing cache key, TTL configurable; hit-rate metric; tune to >60% on replayed traffic.

tasks.title: Timeouts on every outbound call
steps: deadlines everywhere; retry+jitter where idempotent; cost budget alert.
tasks.done_means: grep finds no call without a deadline.

tasks.title: Per-key quotas
steps: quota table + middleware + 429 with headers.

tasks.title: Per-tenant cost dashboard
